scope: One Windows computer, one operator, an RTX 4090 and CPU/RAM. Actual 32B mixed inference and fault recovery; no independent-host, broader-device, public-economic or OS-resource-isolation qualification.
validation_notes: All 183 distinct automated cases passed locally. Repeated tests are not counted as additional cases. The real-model campaigns and working-database restore are additional evidence.

The new unit/socket cases use fabricated allocator/device responses to test rejection and conservation; they are not GPU benchmarks. Actual CUDA/CPU allocations and model output are recorded separately.

All eleven browser journeys passed in one full run, including the actual mixed-model card on desktop/mobile, real streamed chat, contract consent, funding retry, windows, renewal and cooperative consumption. The UI is PT-BR; maintained documentation is English.

CI does not receive private model weights or real GPU credentials. The Linux application job runs three model-independent browser journeys; Windows CI runs four disposable contributor process-tree fixtures. Actual mixed-device inference remains local evidence.

The full fault campaign, the seven-request domain regression and the final-source three-request reload are separately identified. Do not treat them as numerical parity, sustained stress, independent-provider or price evidence.
The first driver startup, model-definition privilege test and competing-model visible-text assertion failed. Their observations, corrections and limits are retained in the linked failure report.

The nine previous migration hashes and F0 evidence are unchanged. Migration 010 was applied once after a backup and is now immutable. It preserved nine existing model definitions and created no grant.

The final extracted source package checked all four currently ready real contributor profiles. Actual guardian parent/boot bindings, original CPU profile fields, mixed route/model binding, all three roots/nodes, LM Studio availability, rendered version and ten applied migration hashes were inspected without writes.

The source package includes the exact bundled Zod dependency and licenses. Windows native guardian/transport binaries, both inference engines, CUDA runtime, Node and model weights remain separately verified prerequisites.
